items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science. The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model-system interfaces with the core search stack: serving, indexing, and retrieval. We research and develop large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to most effectively find and reason over information. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Researcher to lead Search Integrity: the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material. The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolation, while its links, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries. You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production. RESPONSIBILITIES - Define the technical direction for Search Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize. - Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content. - Discover useful signals across page content, links, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation. - Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces. - Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on. - Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE - Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale. - Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems. - An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems. - A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production. - Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work. - A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve. items.title: Compute Electrical Engineer, Robotics
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world environments. Working across the full model and systems stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the physical constraints of real-world systems to improve people’s lives. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an Electrical Engineer to develop the AI inference compute systems that power OpenAI’s humanoid robots. This role combines compute architecture, high-speed digital design, onboard power electronics, and compact HDI PCB development. We’re looking for a self-driven engineer who takes ownership from concept through deployment. items.title: Technical Program Manager, Agent Safety & Security
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead high priority safety and security programs which advance defense in depth for agents, which we have written about publicly . You will be the lead TPM coordinating work across teams to strengthen how we develop and deploy agents safely and securely, and to bring what we build internally to customers and partners so everyone has the tools to safely and securely use Claude. You will be responsible for leading meetings with executives and technical leads, maintaining complex project plans, identifying and addressing risks, developing metrics, and communicating to the company and our customers about this work. Responsibilities: Maintain the roadmap - Maintain and extend the existing roadmap for all work contributing to this effort across the company and implement approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance amidst a fast operational tempo. Turn program goals into measurable exit criteria at each phase of the work - To do this well you’ll need to be responsive to new developments in capabilities and the threat landscape, both of which are evolving fast. Maintain key metrics and dashboards. Run the operating rhythm - Chair the leads meetings, working group meetings, design reviews, and executive check-ins. Record decisions and actions, disseminate sitreps quickly and regularly, and follow up until open issues close. Lead executive and contributor communication - Drive conversations, write regular reports, contribute to design documents, and produce decisional documents as needed. Say plainly what is on track, what is not, and where help is needed. Maintain the risk register - Track risks, exceptions, and risk acceptances in one place and bring hard calls to the right decision maker. Drive company-wide communications - Partner with internal communications on progress updates and on rollouts that change how employees work with Claude every day. Lead through other TPMs - Coordinate subject matter specific TPMs and engineering managers who do not report to you. Set shared standards, spot coverage gaps, and step in to augment capacity where needed. Take coordination load off technical leaders - Find owners for cross-team problems, frame tradeoffs across Security, Safeguards, Research, Privacy, Legal, and Product, manage staffing tasks, and organize exercises that test our controls. Maintain industry context - Track relevant incidents, capabilities shifts, and research across frontier labs, and understand the key risks they reveal. Bring those lessons into our threat model, roadmap, and risk register. You may be a good fit if you: Have led company-wide technical programs, especially a company-wide security program, with multiple workstreams, executive sponsors, and other program managers rolling up to you. Have a strong background in at least one of the program's domains: agent or infrastructure security, ML classifiers and monitoring, evaluations, inference infrastructure, protecting an organization’s most sensitive data, or shipping security controls to customers. You know the terminology and can ramp up on the rest quickly. Have worked closely with ML research teams and understand how models are trained and evaluated. Work independently. You set direction without waiting for instructions and know when to make decisions and when to escalate. Can command a room and hold senior engineers, researchers, and executives accountable without formal authority. Write clearly and fast for any audience, from a one-page executive brief to a company-wide announcement. Use AI tools like Claude to automate tracking, reporting, and follow-up. Care about AI safety and want to help keep powerful systems under human oversight. Have 10+ years of experience in one of the aforementioned areas. Deadline to apply: None, applications will be received on a rolling basis. Annual Salary: TBD with Recruiting. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $365,000 — $435,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Research Engineer, Chip Design RL
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the RL teams Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas: Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies Enhancing model reasoning capabilities We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implementing our research at scale. Our Reinforcement Learning teams sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and engineering excellence, with a deep commitment to building high-quality, scalable systems that push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish. About the role We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to design silicon. Hardware design is difficult and unforgiving – exactly the sort of domain we want Claude to excel at. You'll leverage your chip design expertise and turn it into tasks and signals for models to learn from. Specifically, you will: Invent, design, and implement RL environments and evaluations for agentic RTL generation, design (including formal) verification, physical design optimization. Work on cross-cutting RL considerations such as EDA-tool latency optimization and proxy rewards. Conduct experiments and shape our roadmap. Deliver your work into research and production training runs. Collaborate with other researchers and engineers across and outside Anthropic. You may be a good fit if you: Have expertise in ASIC or FPGA design: RTL, design verification (UVM, formal methods, coverage-driven), physical design (synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure), PPA optimization, DFT, ECOs. Are fluent with industry EDA tools and processes. Have taped out chips and have experience going from spec to silicon. Know how to balance research exploration with engineering implementation. Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems. Strong candidates may also have: Experience with reinforcement learning, evaluations or environments. Built tooling or automation around chip design flows. Worked on ML accelerators or high-performance compute hardware. Familiarity with high-level synthesis or architecture simulators. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $500,000 — $850,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Global Lead, Analyst Relations
items.location_text: Mountain View, CA; San Francisco, CA
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role Glean is looking for an experienced Global Lead, Analyst Relations to own our industry analyst relations program. Reporting to the Director of Communications, you'll be the primary driver of how Glean engages with the research and advisory firms that increasingly shape enterprise AI buying decisions — including Gartner, Forrester, IDC, 451 Research/S&P Global, and emerging firms covering the AI and enterprise search markets. You'll manage Glean's participation in major evaluations like the Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, and IDC MarketScape; run the day-to-day briefing and inquiry calendar; and build durable, trusted relationships with the analysts who cover Glean. This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role for someone who thrives on ownership, organization, and translating product substance into a sharp external narrative. You Will: Schedule, prepare, and run analyst briefings, inquiries, and advisory engagements with top-tier and emerging research firms (Gartner, Forrester, IDC, 451 Research/S&P Global, Everest Group, Omdia, Futurum, and others). Lead Glean's participation in major industry evaluations — including Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, and IDC MarketScapes — managing RFI/questionnaire responses, coordinating input across Product, Product Marketing, and executives, and fact-checking draft analyst profiles before publication. Identify and prepare the right internal spokesperson for each engagement (executive overview, product deep-dive/demo, or technical briefing), and own supporting briefing materials and talk tracks. Build and execute AR plans tied to major launches and company moments, including analyst objectives, target lists, briefing cadence, and success metrics. Manage analyst firm subscriptions and contracts (seats, renewals, access tiers), serving as Glean's primary point of contact for Gartner, IDC, and other research-firm account teams. Serve as the face of Glean to the analyst community — managing relationships proactively, ensuring smooth handoffs during internal personnel transitions, and responding promptly to inbound analyst requests. Conduct ongoing research on the analyst and competitive landscape to keep target analyst lists and firm coverage maps current. Coordinate analyst participation and logistics at major company and industry events (e.g., Glean:GO, AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next), including invite lists and on-site hosting. Draft and distribute analyst-facing communications, including newsletters, product announcement updates, and briefing recaps. Track and report on AR program outcomes — report mentions, positioning, and briefing/inquiry volume — to Product Marketing and Communications leadership. About You: 6+ years of experience in analyst relations, ideally within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology/AI. Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field Proven track record managing end-to-end participation in major analyst evaluations (Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, or equivalent). Existing familiarity with — or a demonstrated ability to quickly build relationships with — analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, 451 Research/S&P Global, and emerging research firms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex product and technical capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for analyst audiences. Highly organized program/project manager who can juggle multiple deadline-driven submission cycles, briefing calendars, and cross-functional stakeholders without dropping details. Comfortable prepping and coaching executives and other spokespeople for high-stakes analyst conversations. A proactive, low-ego operator who can run a program independently while partnering closely with Product Marketing, Communications, Product, and executive stakeholders Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office). items.description: About the Team The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, and Finance to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business. To thrive on this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results. About the Role We are looking for a Pricing Strategist with strong analytical skills and hands-on pricing experience to shape how we price, package, and monetize ChatGPT and Codex, with model pricing as a core part of the role. You’ll work closely with senior leaders across Product, GTM, and Finance to define pricing approaches, improve commercial decision-making, and bring more rigor to how we monetize our offerings. You should be comfortable doing deep analysis, digging into how our products work, and translating that understanding into clear pricing recommendations. You should also care deeply about the customer perspective and believe that strong pricing reflects a real understanding of customer value, needs, and friction points in order to build pricing that is clear, fair, and aligned with how customers experience our products. This role will report to the Head of Product Pricing for Chat & Codex. In this role, you will: - Develop pricing and packaging strategy across plan usage limits and entitlements, credits and overages, and emerging monetization models, balancing customer value, growth, and unit economics. - Analyze customer usage, build financial models, and evaluate pricing experiments to guide decisions on pricing, packaging, and usage allowances, balancing customer value, growth, and unit economics. - Partner with Product, GTM, and Finance leaders to ensure pricing aligns with product value, the roadmap, commercial motions, and overall growth plans. - Develop clear recommendations that are grounded in customer preferences, product value, and market dynamics. - Establish lightweight but effective pricing governance, including decision frameworks, approval processes, and performance tracking. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 6+ years of experience in a strategy role (e.g., consulting or business operations). - Have 3+ years of hands-on pricing and monetization experience, with a track record of developing and launching self-serve subscription or usage-based offerings; experience with sales-led motions is a plus. - Are deeply familiar with various monetization models, including seat-based subscriptions and usage-based pricing models. - Have exceptional analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to independently analyze complex data, build financial models, pressure-test assumptions, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations. - Can balance customer value, product strategy, and commercial outcomes in a thoughtful way. - Are comfortable influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders and navigating ambiguous decisions. - Are a self-starter who can roll up their sleeves and operate comfortably in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on. You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth. REQUIREMENTS - Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration - You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem - You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail - You measure whether what you built worked - Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. - Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. - Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). - Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. - Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. - Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. - Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. - Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks. - Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus - Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. - Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. - Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. - Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). - Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Revenue Operations Manager, APAC
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Revenue Operations Manager to partner closely with APAC sales leadership, drive commercial planning and performance, and build a growing team focused on improving sales execution across the region. Based in Singapore, you will support a 100+ person GTM organization across Southeast Asia, ANZ, India, South Korea, and Japan. You will navigate the needs of markets at different stages of growth, balancing regional priorities with the development of consistent, scalable operating practices. As part of the global RevOps organization, you will work across analytics, systems, and operations to turn business insights and field feedback into improvements in sales execution and productivity. You will also help shape how we leverage AI and automation to simplify processes, reduce manual work, and enable our sales teams to move faster. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Partner with regional leadership on commercial strategy. Evaluate growth opportunities and business performance across APAC markets, translate regional objectives into quarterly priorities, and recommend where to focus sales resources and investments. 2. Own territory planning and execution. Lead territory design, rollout and ongoing management with Sales and global RevOps; align account allocation to market potential, seller capacity and ramp, and resolve coverage gaps. 3. Drive capacity and quota planning. Partner with Sales, Finance and RevOps on headcount, capacity and regional quotas; translate plans into territory targets and track attainment. 4. Shape regional pipeline targets. Partner with Sales and Marketing to establish pipeline creation and coverage targets, identify gaps across markets and segments, and develop targeted actions to improve pipeline health and conversion. 5. Run the regional operating cadence. Lead weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews that produce decisions, owners and deadlines; track performance, escalate blockers and close out actions. 6. Strengthen forecast discipline. Challenge assumptions with sales leaders and managers, inspect changes and surface risks, slippage and upside early. 7. Improve productivity through AI and automation. Gather seller and leadership feedback, prioritize opportunities with GTM Systems, define requirements, pilot improvements and measure adoption, time saved and execution speed. 8. Deliver cross-functional change. Represent APAC in global initiatives, surface regional business needs to global teams, and coordinate implementation and adoption across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and GTM Systems. MUST-HAVES - Experience leading and developing sales operations, revenue operations or commercial business partnership teams across the APAC region - A track record of translating analysis into action and measurable results. - Credibility with senior sales leaders and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority. - Strong commercial judgment across territories, capacity, quotas, pipeline, forecasting and seller productivity. - Experience delivering cross-functional improvements in a growing B2B technology business. - Ability to operate independently, prioritize competing business needs, and drive execution in a fast-paced, evolving organization. NICE-TO-HAVES - Experience supporting sales organizations across multiple APAC markets. - Experience building and scaling commercial operations in a high-growth organization. - Experience identifying and implementing process improvements through automation and AI. FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS - Analytical problem solving. - Clear communication and constructive challenge. - Prioritization, ownership and follow-through. - Coaching and delegation. - Process improvement and AI/automation judgment. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Regional leaders have clear priorities backed by evidence and practical action plans. - Territories, capacity and quotas are aligned to regional opportunity and field realities. - Pipeline and performance gaps trigger timely interventions with measured outcomes. - Business reviews consistently produce decisions and completed follow-up. - Business partners earn leaders’ trust and operate with increasing independence. - Seller feedback leads to adopted process improvements that save time and accelerate execution. - Regional feedback improves global priorities, and global initiatives are used effectively in the field. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Head of Transactional Processing
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: The Head of Transactional Processing is being hired to lead the global transactional finance teams at Genius Sports. Continuing to manage all transactional processing in one organizational pillar. This team plays a critical role in driving change and excellence in Accounts Receivable (invoicing and collections), Accounts Payable and Payroll. The role will report directly to the SVP Controllership and play a key role in driving the finance team forwards and optimizing the way the finance team is organized. Duties & Responsibilities Oversee and manage the Accounts Receivable team of 6 people, led by the Accounts Receivable Controller to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. Oversee and manage the Accounts Payable team of 6 people led by the Accounts Payable Controller Oversee and manage the payroll team of 6 led by the Global Payroll Manager Develop and implement efficient processes and workflows across transactional functions, driving improvements in speed, accuracy and reliability. Drive project and process improvements in the teams including; AP – roll out of PO/credit card alignment, OCR and standardised AP processing AR – automated billing project, best in class credit control and improved accuracy Payroll – work to define clear roles and responsibilities between people and finance teams and align globally. Drive the global payroll project alongside people team and ensure common global accounting for payroll under one shared vision Establish KPIs for the transactional processing team, monitoring performance and delivering constructive feedback to drive performance improvements. Maintain strong relationships with customers and internal commercial stakeholders, ensuring timely and effective resolution of any discrepancies. Build a strong focus on credit control to drive improvements in aging, bad debt and write offs. Ensure all transactional processing is aligned with the company’s financial controls and governance standards. Manage month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes across accounts payable, receivable and payroll to meet reporting deadlines. Build a strong team culture across both local and international team elements. Ensuring the team is driving towards process improvements and efficiency Lead, mentor, and develop a team of transactional processing professionals, promoting a culture of continuous improvement. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, working with IT and finance to implement new solutions. Complete roll-out of consistent transactional processes across the entire Group and acquisition entities. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: Deep experience in working in transactional teams in industry is essential Experience in leading and transforming transactional teams across multi service line organizations Strong interpersonal skills and experience in dealing with commercial teams Strong understanding of ERP systems including Workday finance Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a high level of attention to detail Proven experience managing teams and developing team members in a high-paced environment Advanced knowledge of best practices in transactional processing Effective communicator, with a collaborative approach to cross-departmental projects An ethos of continuous improvement of systems, processes and ways of working Experience in a US listed environment is useful with a working knowledge of SOX controls We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: Senior Payroll Officer
items.description: Easygo is the Australian technology powerhouse behind global brands Stake , KICK , and Easygo Gaming . As we continue to grow our presence in Serbia, we’re strengthening our local People & Culture operations and looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Officer to join us in Belgrade. This is an opportunity to take ownership of payroll operations for our Serbian entities, Easygo Tech Europe and MB Care , supporting 200+ employees while working closely with our local People & Culture and Finance teams, as well as our global team in Melbourne. You’ll play an important role in bringing our payroll operations in-house — leading the transition from an external payroll provider to Pantheon, improving data accuracy, and helping us build more efficient and consistent payroll processes as the business continues to grow. The Role As Senior Payroll Officer, you’ll be a key member of our People & Culture team, responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing across our Serbian entities. The role combines hands-on payroll management with HR administration, systems integration, and process improvement. You’ll work closely with local and global stakeholders, support employees with payroll-related queries, and contribute to the development of our internal payroll operations. Key Responsibilities Payroll Processing: Manage monthly payroll processing for 200+ employees across Easygo Tech and MB Care, ensuring accuracy, timely payments, and compliance with Serbian regulations and internal policies. Payroll Compliance: Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation in line with Serbian payroll and accounting regulations, ensuring readiness for tax and labour inspections. Payroll Reporting: Assist with month-end reconciliations and prepare payroll-related reports and documentation, working closely with Finance. HR Administration: Manage payroll-related HR administration, including employee registrations, deregistrations and changes through CROSO, sick leave administration via eBolovanje/RFZO, and relevant processes through ePorezi. Employee Support: Act as a key point of contact for payroll-related queries, ensuring employees receive accurate information and timely support. Payroll Changes: Collaborate with People & Culture to ensure accurate and timely processing of new hires, terminations, salary adjustments, leave, overtime, and other payroll changes. Contractor Payments: Process contractor invoices, reconcile vendor accounts, resolve discrepancies, and manage queries related to contractor payments. Payroll Transformation: Support the transition from an external payroll provider to an in-house payroll function using Pantheon, working closely with implementation partners and internal teams. Systems Integration: Support and maintain the integration between HiBob and Pantheon, ensuring employee data, leave, overtime, and salary changes flow accurately between systems. Process Improvement: Identify and resolve data inconsistencies between HR and payroll systems, improve data accuracy, and help automate payroll processes across both Serbian entities. Who You Are Payroll Experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Serbian payroll processing. Serbian Payroll Expert: Strong knowledge of Serbian payroll and accounting regulations, with experience ensuring accurate and compliant payroll processing. Systems Knowledge: Working knowledge of Pantheon or a strong willingness and ability to quickly learn the system. Excel Skills: Good knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functions. Attention to Detail: Highly accurate and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on ensuring payroll and financial data is correct. Organised & Reliable: Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities. Clear Communicator: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across People & Culture, Finance, and external partners. English Proficiency: Excellent command of English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate confidently with international stakeholders. Bonus points if you also have: Payroll Transformation: Experience transitioning payroll from an external provider to an in-house or ERP-based payroll system. HR Systems: Experience with HiBob or a comparable HRIS, particularly integrating employee data, leave, overtime, and salary changes with payroll processing. Financial Reporting: Exposure to Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) concepts, including cost-centre allocations and departmental cost reporting. Accounting Knowledge: A basic understanding of general accounting principles. Why Join Easygo? Performance Reward: Annual bonus linked to individual and company performance. Professional Growth: Clear opportunities for development, learning, and career progression within a global organization. Health & Wellbeing: Private health insurance for you and your dependents. Office Perks: Daily catered lunch, snacks and beverages, parking reimbursement, and a modern Belgrade office. Global Exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with — and occasionally visit — our Melbourne headquarters . Team Culture: Regular team-building activities and a professional, collaborative working environment. We’re an office-first workplace because we believe the best collaboration, communication, and team connections happen when we work together in person. Our Belgrade office is our primary place of work, while we still offer flexibility to work from home when needed . Come as you are. Be part of something bigger. Click play on your career today.

items.title: Critical Infrastructure Engineering Lead
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Our mission Serve as Mistral AI’s senior technical authority for critical electrical, mechanical and life-safety infrastructure across assigned colocation sites. Protect the availability of high-density AI compute by identifying technical risks before they become incidents, challenging infrastructure operating practices and verifying that power and cooling systems perform within agreed requirements. Operating context & accountability Working with Engineering Operations leadership, IT Operations, hardware partners and colocation providers, you will provide hands-on technical assurance across a site or cluster. You will assess provider performance, advise on critical decisions, support incident response and ensure operational learning drives durable improvements. The role focuses on technical oversight and influence rather than direct management of the colocation provider’s maintenance workforce. Technical assurance and operational risk - Own and maintain the site technical risk register, including electrical and mechanical single points of failure, maintenance exposure, redundancy limitations, cooling capacity, liquid-cooling interfaces and common-mode failure scenarios. - Assess the resilience of utility connections, MV/LV distribution, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busways, protection systems, pumps, cooling plant, controls and monitoring against the contracted operating envelope. - Review provider preventive maintenance strategies, schedules, critical asset condition and outstanding defects; identify maintenance deferrals and vulnerabilities that may affect AI compute availability. - Critically review high-risk methods of procedure, electrical switching and isolation plans, planned impairments, work sequencing, contingency measures, rollback plans and restoration criteria. - Validate the completeness and quality of technical documentation, including single-line diagrams, P&IDs, operating sequences, alarm matrices, capacity records, asset registers and operating procedures. - Use BMS/EPMS trends, alarms, power-quality records and cooling telemetry to identify abnormal operating conditions, capacity constraints and deteriorating resilience before service is affected. Incident response, investigations and reliability - Act as a senior engineering escalation point during major infrastructure incidents; rapidly assess failure domain, remaining redundancy, safety implications, likely IT impact and viable restoration options. - Coordinate technical information across the colocation provider, Mistral IT Operations and OEM partners, ensuring accurate incident timelines, risk communication and controlled return to service. - Review and challenge root-cause analyses, distinguishing immediate triggers from underlying design, maintenance, controls, process and organizational contributors. - Define and follow up corrective and preventive actions, requesting evidence of implementation and verifying that recurring failure modes have been addressed. - Identify systemic trends across sites and share lessons learned with engineering design, commissioning and regional operations teams. - Support emergency response planning and tabletop exercises covering loss of utility, cooling failures, liquid leaks, fire/life-safety events and critical equipment failures. Capacity delivery, commissioning and change control - Participate in design and constructability reviews for expansions, retrofits and new AI deployments; flag operational, maintainability and resilience concerns early. - Review commissioning and integrated systems testing plans, including power transfers, redundancy scenarios, controls failure modes, cooling recovery and operational readiness criteria. - Challenge test results and acceptance evidence against defined electrical, thermal and operational requirements; track unresolved technical issues through handover. - Partner with IT Operations on rack power and thermal limits, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution unit boundaries, leak response and load-restoration dependencies. - Assess proposed changes to critical infrastructure, including concurrent maintenance, controls updates and brownfield works; recommend safeguards and escalation where exposure is unacceptable. - Provide technical coaching to internal stakeholders, contribute to engineering standards and support recruitment and knowledge sharing as the portfolio expands. Success measures - Critical technical risks are identified early, prioritized and reduced through verified mitigation actions, supporting Mistral’s availability objectives. - High-risk maintenance and infrastructure changes receive timely, evidence-based technical review with clear mitigations and escalation. - Major incidents are diagnosed accurately, communicated effectively and followed by robust root-cause analysis and verified corrective actions. - New and expanded capacity meets agreed redundancy, electrical, cooling and operational acceptance requirements. - Repeat failures, unresolved high-severity defects and preventable technical deviations decrease over time. Minimum qualifications - 5–7+ years in critical facilities engineering, commissioning, data center operations or technical assurance in high-availability environments. - Strong practical knowledge of critical electrical infrastructure (UPS, generators, MV/LV distribution, switchgear and protection) and mechanical systems (cooling plant, pumps, controls and heat rejection). - Ability to review single-line diagrams, operating sequences, technical procedures, maintenance plans, commissioning evidence and root-cause analyses. - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and influencing external technical teams without direct line authority. - Clear written and verbal English communication, sound judgment under pressure and willingness to travel and participate in incident escalation as needed. Preferred experience - Full technical governance, multi-site operations or mission-critical facilities serving high-density AI/HPC workloads. - Experience with direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility/technology cooling interfaces, water quality, leak detection and rack-level thermal management. - Integrated systems testing, EPMS/BMS trend analysis, protection coordination, failure-mode reviews and cross-site engineering standardization. - Experience partnering with hardware OEMs, design engineers, commissioning teams and infrastructure providers during live-site expansion. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Design & Reliability Engineering Manager
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Our mission Shape the engineering foundations of Mistral AI’s next generation of compute capacity while improving the resilience of the infrastructure already in service. This role combines technical design leadership with field reliability engineering: you will establish demanding, practical requirements for colocation power and cooling, scrutinize proposed solutions and turn operating experience into better designs, safer changes and more reliable AI capacity. Operating context & accountability Mistral deploys high-density AI infrastructure in colocation facilities, where partners operate the underlying critical plant. You will be Mistral’s technical counterpart to providers, designers, commissioning specialists and internal IT and capacity teams. The position combines forward-looking design authority with hands-on technical investigation and portfolio reliability improvement. It requires depth in one core engineering discipline and the judgment to lead multidisciplinary decisions with specialist support. Key responsibilities — design and technical standards - Own and continuously improve Mistral’s technical design criteria and colocation requirements for new facilities, expansions and retrofits, including availability objectives, failure domains, maintainability and operational flexibility. - Translate GPU platform roadmaps into measurable facility envelopes: IT load and transients, rack density, electrical topology, redundancy, cooling capacity, supply/return temperatures, flow, pressure, water quality and monitoring. - Review utility and MV/LV arrangements, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busway, protection coordination, earthing, power quality and metering for suitability under demanding AI loads. - Review mechanical and controls architecture, including chilled-water and heat-rejection systems, pumps, control sequences, CDU integration, leak detection, filtration, water treatment and cooling recovery scenarios. - Lead multidisciplinary reviews of single-line diagrams, P&IDs, sequences of operation, design calculations, capacity models, failure-mode studies and proposed deviations; document risks and decisions. - Participate in site selection, technical due diligence, provider RFPs, design milestones and commercial technical schedules, challenging assumptions before they become delivery constraints. - Define design review and exception processes that balance performance, resilience, deployment speed, efficiency, capital cost and long-term operability. Key responsibilities — commissioning and delivery assurance - Partner with delivery and commissioning teams to define functional and integrated testing requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence packages and outstanding-defect management. - Validate that electrical and cooling infrastructure can support the contracted AI load envelope under normal, maintenance and credible fault conditions. - Review test scripts and results for loss of utility, UPS/generator transitions, cooling component failures, controls faults, CDU interface events and staged restoration where applicable. - Ensure operational handover includes accurate drawings, asset and interface registers, monitoring points, setpoints, maintenance constraints, emergency procedures and unresolved risk ownership. - Support live-site changes and capacity upgrades with a disciplined review of impact, sequencing, rollback plans and operational readiness. Key responsibilities — field reliability and root-cause analysis - Act as a technical escalation point for recurring or high-impact electrical, mechanical and controls incidents across operational colocation sites. - Analyze alarms, BMS/EPMS trends, event sequences, power-quality records, cooling telemetry, commissioning findings and maintenance evidence to distinguish symptoms from systemic causes. - Lead or challenge technical root-cause investigations with colocation partners, including common-mode failures, protection miscoordination, thermal instability, control logic, hydraulic performance and hidden capacity limitations. - Develop risk-ranked corrective actions and reliability improvement programs; validate effectiveness through evidence and post-change monitoring. - Identify fleet-wide patterns and feed lessons learned into reference designs, acceptance tests, technical specifications and provider governance. - Review maintenance and change proposals that create material exposure to compute availability, providing clear technical recommendations and escalation where required. Key responsibilities — collaboration and leadership - Work with IT hardware, network and platform teams to understand the operational consequences of rack-level and cluster-level failure domains. - Influence colocation providers, consultants and OEM partners through technically rigorous, fact-based reviews without relying on direct operational authority. - Present design trade-offs, reliability risks and investment recommendations in language accessible to engineering leadership and business stakeholders. - Develop reusable standards, technical playbooks and engineering knowledge sharing to support consistent decisions across a rapidly expanding portfolio. What success looks like - New capacity is accepted against well-defined electrical, thermal and resilience criteria with transparent technical exceptions. - Design risks are identified early, reducing late changes, stranded capacity and avoidable operational constraints. - Repeat incidents and unresolved critical engineering defects decrease as corrective actions are verified. - Field experience produces measurable improvements to future designs and live-site operating resilience. Minimum qualifications - At least 8 years in mission-critical data center design, engineering, commissioning or technical reliability, including responsibility for complex technical decisions. - Degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent professional experience, with deep knowledge in one discipline and strong working knowledge of the other. - Demonstrated expertise in critical power and cooling architecture, redundancy, failure-mode analysis and operational risk management. - Experience reviewing engineering drawings, calculations, commissioning evidence and root-cause analyses, and coordinating technical specialists. - Ability to influence colocation providers and cross-functional stakeholders; excellent English communication and willingness to travel. Preferred qualifications - Experience with AI/HPC infrastructure, high-density accelerator platforms and direct-to-chip liquid cooling. - Knowledge of CDUs, facility-to-technology cooling interfaces, hydraulic performance, cooling-water quality and leak management. - Experience with electrical protection/selectivity, power quality, controls sequences, integrated systems testing and BMS/EPMS analytics. - Experience creating technical standards across multiple sites or providers, including design deviations and fleet-wide reliability improvements. - Professional engineering registration or equivalent technical credentials. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
