items.title: Financial Data and Controls Lead, Billing Platform
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a Financial Data and Controls Lead to join our Billing Platform team. Billing Platform builds the systems customers use to transact with Anthropic: subscriptions, usage billing, quote to cash, invoicing, and payments. You'll be the dedicated owner of billing accuracy, reconciliation, and financial controls across those systems, making sure the right checks run, the right controls are in place, and the audit evidence exists. Our billing systems and pricing change often, and each flow needs to meet SOX requirements. Accurate billing is what lets us launch products and pricing quickly and still close the books on time. The hard problems today include validating negotiated pricing from contract to invoice, handling the many forms of credits, app store billing, and keeping controls current while the systems under them are replaced. This is a foundational role and the first hire of its kind on the team. You'll lead a working group of the reconciliation and controls owners from each billing engineering team, and you'll set the approach they follow. You'll work closely with Finance Systems, Accounting, Internal Audit, and Data Engineering. The role sits in Engineering and works with Finance every day. Our Data organization builds the pipelines and owns the warehouse, and you'll use that data and partner with that team. We're looking for an engineer or data practitioner with strong accounting domain knowledge, who can talk to engineers about systems and to Finance and auditors about risk and materiality. Key responsibilities Own reconciliation and accuracy checks for critical billing data (quantity, price, discounts, and invoices) across our product platform, third-party billing and payment providers, app stores, cloud marketplaces, and in-house systems Design and run detective controls that catch billing errors before they reach the accounting books Partner with billing engineering teams to turn repeat checks into automated verifiers Review billing changes that have financial impact, flag the ones that touch SOX or IT application controls (ITACs), and make sure functional test evidence is in place Make SOX review a standard, lightweight step in how billing changes ship, treated like a security review, so launches are not delayed by it Own the end-to-end test strategy and audit evidence for those changes, working with Finance Systems, Data Engineering, Accounting, and Internal Audit Triage billing errors, prioritize backfills and fixes with the owning teams, and track materiality over time Define and maintain the data contracts between billing and finance systems, so downstream teams can find and trust the data they need Lead the working group of reconciliation and controls owners across billing engineering teams, through influence and not reporting lines Act as the Billing owner, alongside Accounting and Finance Systems, for translating the product and pricing roadmap into financial impact, test strategy, and process updates Minimum qualifications Experience building or owning a financial ledger, billing reconciliation, or cash reconciliation system end to end, one that Accounting relied on to close the books Hands-on SQL skills strong enough to take two messy datasets (for example usage events and invoices), match them, find the breaks, and explain the root cause Accounting domain knowledge (order to cash, month-end close, and materiality) sufficient to tell which billing changes have financial impact Experience working with SOX and Internal Audit teams on IT application controls, detective controls, transaction monitoring, functional test evidence, and auditor walkthroughs Experience defining data contracts between billing or product systems and finance systems such as the ERP, general ledger, or revenue recognition Track record of driving work across Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Audit without direct authority Ability to explain technical issues to Finance and auditors in their terms, and financial risk to engineers in theirs Interest in AI and a commitment to Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI systems Preferred qualifications Background as a backend, data, or analytics engineer who built a financial ledger or cash reconciliation system from scratch Experience running these systems under public company reporting requirements, and scaling them as the company grew Experience with usage-based or consumption billing Experience with multi-party billing, such as marketplaces, or app stores Experience turning manual checks into automated verifiers with engineering teams Experience remediating a control deficiency, or standing up a controls program while the underlying systems were changing A track record of using Claude or other AI tools to automate reconciliation, testing, or evidence collection, with checks that hold up to review Experience with billing and finance tools such as Stripe, Metronome, Zuora, NetSuite, or Workday Financials Python for data analysis or automation The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $345,000 — $425,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. Overview Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics Holdings, Inc. As a Staff Engineer on the Payments team, you will be the technical owner of the systems that move money into, out of, and across Fanatics: deposits, withdrawals, and payments at checkout. The platform you will own serves Sportsbook and Casino today and is being extended to other Fanatics businesses. A key part of that work is letting a customer's shared balance appear as a payment option alongside cards and bank transfers wherever they shop, so that money already held at Fanatics does not have to leave and come back. You will also shape how Fanatics connects to processors, acquirers, and banking partners, with the aim of improving approval rates, lowering cost per transaction, and reducing the number of times the same funds are moved. This role combines deep backend expertise with architectural leadership. You will set the technical direction for payments across several teams and work closely with Fraud, Responsible Gaming, Finance, Legal, and Compliance partners to build payment flows that are reliable, cost-effective, and compliant with state regulations and card scheme rules. Responsibilities Own the architecture of the payments platform, including provider integrations, deposit and withdrawal flows, and the services other Fanatics businesses call to take payment. Design and build distributed services in Java and Spring Boot that process high transaction volume with strict requirements for correctness, security, and uptime. Build payment orchestration and routing across processors, acquirers, and payment methods, using approval rate, cost, and provider health to decide where each transaction goes, with failover when a provider degrades. Handle failure in third-party integrations by design, including timeouts, retries, idempotency, duplicate callbacks, partial failures, and reconciliation against provider and bank settlement files. Lead the technical work of onboarding new providers and banking partners, including evaluating options and defining the integration, testing, and rollout approach. Build in regulatory and card scheme requirements, such as per-jurisdiction rules and how transactions are classified, in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Finance. Work with Fraud and Risk to bring risk signals into the payment path and to handle chargebacks and disputes, including how they are attributed when funds are used across businesses. Reduce payment cost through routing, provider terms, and design choices that avoid unnecessary movement of money. Set standards for security, data handling, and limiting PCI scope across payment services. Lead architectural reviews, design sessions, and incident postmortems, and mentor engineers across the team. Partner with product, frontend, and mobile teams so that payment experiences are consistent and clear for customers. Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices or industry events for planning, collaboration, and team development. Required Qualifications 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot. Experience building and operating payment systems in production, such as deposit and withdrawal flows, payment gateway or processor integrations, card payments, or ACH. Strong understanding of idempotency, reconciliation, and failure handling in systems that depend on third-party providers. Experience designing secure, high-scale, low-latency distributed systems. Experience with event-driven architectures and message streaming platforms such as Kafka. Working knowledge of security and compliance requirements for handling payment data, including PCI DSS. Demonstrated success setting technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams. Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, finance, and leadership audiences. Comfort working in a fast-paced, regulated environment with changing priorities. Preferred Qualifications Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, or banking. Knowledge of how card networks, acquirers, and issuers work, including interchange, transaction classification, and chargeback processes. Experience with payment orchestration, smart routing, or building a payments platform that serves several business units. Experience integrating with banking partners or building account funding and money movement products. Experience with financial reconciliation and settlement reporting. Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch. Interest in developer experience, clean API design, and systems that remain maintainable as more teams depend on them. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ #LI-VG1 Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ Salary Range $190,000 — $237,500 USD By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.title: CISO
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role Glean is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead security for Glean as a company and for our core product. Reporting to the CTO, you will set the strategy and operating model across product and platform security, corporate security, detection and response, risk, and compliance, turning that strategy into measurable risk reduction. This is an executive role for a leader who combines technical judgment with strong organizational leadership. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, IT, and company leadership to make sound security decisions at the pace of an AI company. You should be able to go deep on architecture and incidents, build a durable program, and communicate clearly about risk and trade-offs. You will Set a risk-based security strategy, priorities, policies, metrics, and decision-making mechanisms that scale with Glean’s business. Give executives a clear view of material risks, remediation progress, and decisions that require business ownership, with a clear operating cadence to ensure risks are visible, owned, prioritized, and reduced. Partner with Engineering and Product to build security into architecture, design, development, release, and operations. Guide security across application and platform layers, identity and authorization, customer-data flows, cloud environments, integrations, and AI-enabled capabilities, including models, agents, and the tools and data they can access. Lead a measurable vulnerability-management and secure-development program spanning threat modeling, code and dependency risk, software supply-chain security, penetration testing, bug bounty, remediation ownership, and validation. Use automation and AI-assisted analysis thoughtfully to increase coverage and shorten time to fix. Oversee security for corporate systems, identity, endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure, and privileged access. Partner with IT and technical owners to improve preventive controls, monitoring, and operational resilience. Ensure the organization can detect, assess, contain, recover from, and learn from security incidents. Clarify escalation and decision paths; coordinate with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Communications, and business leaders; and ensure corrective actions are completed and validated. Own security risk management, compliance strategy, audit readiness, and control effectiveness. Support frameworks and customer or regulatory requirements relevant to Glean’s business, which may include SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, and FedRAMP. Track meaningful outcomes in risk reduction, vulnerability remediation, incident readiness, and control effectiveness. Build and grow a high-performing team across security engineering, enterprise security, detection and response, and governance. Set clear ownership, develop technical and people leaders, and create an environment where teams can execute with focus and accountability. Build strong working relationships across the company, helping teams understand practical safeguards and make informed risk decisions without unnecessary friction. Partner with customer-facing security leaders on escalations and assurance needs. Contribute security expertise to commercial security products in partnership with their Product and business owners; those teams retain ownership of their product roadmaps. About you Senior security leadership experience with accountability for a broad, enterprise-scale security program at a high-growth technology or product company. Experience as a CISO, deputy CISO, or senior security executive is strongly preferred. Strong technical depth across product and application security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management, secure development, and vulnerability management. You can engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture and remediation choices. Experience building and operating effective security, detection, and incident-response programs, including leading through high-severity incidents and ensuring lessons result in durable improvements. Practical expertise in security risk management, governance, compliance, and audit readiness, with the judgment to distinguish control completion from actual risk reduction. A track record of partnering with Product and Engineering to ship secure products and embed security in fast-moving development organizations. Experience building, leading, and retaining strong multidisciplinary teams; setting priorities; allocating resources; and creating clear accountability across teams. Excellent executive communication and judgment. You can explain technical issues and uncertainty plainly, recommend a path forward, and escalate material risk at the right time. You bring a collaborative, pragmatic leadership style that earns trust while holding a high bar for security outcomes. Especially valuable: Experience securing enterprise AI, machine-learning, LLM, or agentic systems, including data handling, model and application boundaries, tool access, and adversarial testing; using automation or AI-enabled techniques to improve security analysis, detection, investigation, or remediation; supporting regulated customers or programs such as FedRAMP; or preparing a company for public-company or IPO-level governance and disclosure expectations. Location This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco Bay Area office). Compensation & Benefits The standard base salary range for this position is $424,300 - $489,400 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.
